messages.subject: trouble with reverse tickmarks
parts:
Hi list,

commands that use the back tick marks, e.g. when subset from a list:

sapply(list, `[[`, "elementname")

print as a formatted left single quote in the resulting pdf.  Copy-pasting from the pdf into R interprets that as some unidentified symbol, rather than ther proper tick mark. 

(using knitr 0.2, ubuntu 11.10, R 2.14.1)

Can anyone replicate this problem and/or suggest a solution?

Carl

--
Carl Boettiger
UC Davis
